snippet.title: Realmwake — Gameplay Trailer | Demo now live on Steam!
snippet.description:
Realmwake is a grid-based roguelike autobattler about building an army from across four distinct realms. Position units to exploit their abilities and synergies, manage limited resources, and chart a path through 12 days of battles, shops, and unpredictable encounters.
Play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5552620/Realmwake/
Play the free demo on itch.io: https://chefpepper.itch.io/realmwake
Join the discord to talk to the developer and be a part of the community! https://discord.gg/Hq3dFrTURc
